visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a dimly lit studio-like environment with industrial ceilings and spotlights. A young man in a black T-shirt vigorously pulls a launcher, releasing a spinning top into a clear plastic tub on a wooden table while his friends watch from nearby sofas. (2) A transition to a black screen with white centered text appears briefly before cutting to a top-down view of a smartphone screen displaying a chat interface. (3) The visual shifts to a high-angle shot of a Beyblade battle arena on a table; colorful tops collide at high speeds while hands occasionally enter the frame to interact with the objects. (4) Multiple cuts show young men in casual attire cheering and reacting with high energy as the tops spin and fly out of the arena. (5) The video transitions to a clear, bright screen recording of the Mercari mobile application, demonstrating searching, scrolling through listings of Beyblade sets, and selecting a specific high-value item. (6) Close-up shots of the app interface illustrate the checkout process, including language settings, shipping options like 7-ELEVEN, and final purchase buttons with red highlights. (7) The final phase returns to the arena for a high-intensity battle with multiple Beyblades clashing simultaneously, followed by a bright white screen showing the Mercari logo and call-to-action text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo, energetic rock music bed featuring driving drums and electric guitar. A male voice speaks with high enthusiasm, punctuated by the sharp 'click' and 'whir' of a Beyblade launcher and the metallic clashing of spinning tops. (2) As the narrator describes his loss of interest, the music remains consistent, but several 'whoosh' transition effects signal scene changes. A loud 'clack' sounds as a top hits the arena wall. (3) The scene shifts to the tutorial phase; digital 'blip' and 'swipe' UI sound effects are layered over the voice as it explains the Mercari app. The background music maintains a constant energy level. (4) During the excitement of the 'three in one' shot, the audio features a chorus of male cheers and shouting ('Whoa!'), mixed with rapid-fire percussive collisions from the tops. (5) The video concludes with a finalized slogan delivered by the narrator over a melodic synth riser and a final clean fade-out of the music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Storytelling -> Solution Presentation -> Tutorial -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the Mercari Taiwan shopping platform as an efficient and cost-effective way for hobbyists to purchase second-hand Beyblade sets and equipment directly from Japan.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names Mercari, demonstrates its app interface, explains its benefits for the specific hobby, and provides a clear call to action to search for the brand.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A highly effective social-media-style advertisement that leverages 'retiring' hobbyists' inventory to attract new or returning players through price sensitivity and convenience.
